meta.title: STG/EML Primary Healthcare 2024 — Materia seed gap triage
meta.note: Coverage triage only. Do NOT copy numeric doses from the PDF into Materia. Publish clinical values only after founder review with source + review gate.
limitations: PHC 2024 PDF used as coverage pointer — Paediatric Hospital STG is a separate gap source
Name extraction from public PDF text can include class headings and non-INN phrases; priority list is curated
Blood products, devices, vaccines-as-programmes, and ORS sachets may be out of molecule-page scope
Some PHC medicines already exist under short seed IDs (e.g. mol-nitro = nitrofurantoin)

outOfMoleculeScope: Oral rehydration solution / homemade SSS as a product page (supportive care, not a single INN)
Anti-D immunoglobulin and other blood products / immunoglobulins
Class headings (ACE-inhibitors, SSRIs, benzodiazepines, potent corticosteroids)
